architecture.mechanism: Three-arm differential observability with witness-ratio guard for fouling diagnostics
architecture.intervention: Implement a 3-arm differential manifold with a witness-ratio guard (τref = |rref(t) − rref,0|/rref,0 > 0.03) to distinguish biofilm fouling from reversible concentration polarization in the RO train, enabling targeted antifouling interventions without chlorine
architecture.expected_effect: Reduce normalized flux droop to <5% between cleans by isolating biofouling events from reversible fouling, extending CIP intervals to quarterly while maintaining 40,000 m3/day recovery
architecture.falsification_test: Deploy the 3-arm manifold on one RO stage and compare fouling detection accuracy (τref threshold crossings) against the 2-arm baseline; validate that >90% of CIP triggers correlate with biofouling (not CP) via post-clean membrane autopsy
